purpose: Teach: バリ島/ディスコ/四重奏/チューリップ/ショコラ/ミカン/バルコニー/苺

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがバリ島出張から戻ってこられたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's back from his business trip to Bali.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. A small smile in the delivery—pleased he's home. Speaking to Sho directly, expecting his attention. No pressure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが若い頃ディスコに通われたんだって
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me he used to go to discos when he was young.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful wonder. The discovery is genuine—he's turning it over in his mind. Not dramatic, just... noticing something new about his father. Soft curiosity.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと四重奏の演奏会に行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, how about we go to that quartet concert with your father?
lines.style: Inviting, warm. A suggestion offered as a gift—not a command. She's including him in something she thinks he'll like. Gentle expectation of yes.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お庭にチューリップを植えたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to plant tulips in the garden.
lines.style: Bright, direct desire. The thought has just arrived—he's sharing it immediately. Small eagerness, not demanding. Open, hopeful tone.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがショコラを買ってこられたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father brought home chocolate for you.
lines.style: Calm delivery of a small pleasure. A gentle reveal—she's watching to see if he's pleased. Practical warmth, no fanfare.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんのミカン箱、また欲しい
lines.en: Mom, I want Grandma's orange box again.
lines.style: Soft persistence. He remembers something good and wants it back. Not whiny—just plainly stating his want. A small, clear voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがバルコニーで花火見ましょうって
lines.en: Sho, your father wants to watch fireworks from the balcony together.
lines.style: Warm invitation wrapped in a simple statement. She's passing along his father's idea—there's affection in the relay. Inviting Sho to imagine it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、苺狩りに行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to go strawberry picking.
lines.style: Clear, eager brightness. The image is vivid in his mind—he's almost there already. Open and genuine. A child's direct joy.
